title: Mechanistic Interpretability for End-to-End Self-Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.41185v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving models achieve strong planning performance but remain largely opaque, limiting observability and trust. We apply mechanistic interpretability to E2E driving by training Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) on the internal activations of a simple, single-camera end-to-end path planning model. Unsupervised clustering of SAE latents reveals interpretable structure aligned with route intent, vehicle speed, and braking behavior, recovering route intent with 98.3% accuracy without supervision. Through paired counterfactual image edits, we further show that specific SAE features are visually grounded and systematically respond to scene changes such as traffic light state and stop sign presence. Steering individual SAE latents produces predictable, monotonic changes in planner outputs including lateral displacement, curvature, and braking. translated_title: 端到端自动驾驶的机制可解释性研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.41185v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：端到端（E2E）自动驾驶模型在规划性能上表现出色，但其内部机制在很大程度上仍不透明，限制了可观测性和信任度。我们通过在一个简单的单相机端到端路径规划模型的内部激活上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），将机制可解释性方法应用于端到端驾驶。对SAE潜在特征进行无监督聚类，揭示了与路线意图、车辆速度和制动行为相一致的可解释结构，并在无监督条件下以98.3%的准确率恢复了路线意图。通过成对的反事实图像编辑，我们进一步表明特定的SAE特征具有视觉基础，并能系统性地响应场景变化，例如交通灯状态和停车标志的存在。操纵单个SAE潜在特征会对规划器的输出产生可预测的、单调的变化，包括横向位移、曲率和制动。最后，我们展示了这些表示的一个实际应用：我们构……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究首次将机制可解释性应用于端到端自动驾驶模型，通过训练稀疏自编码器发现模型内部与路线意图、车辆速度和制动行为相关的可解释特征，并证明操纵这些特征可以可预测地改变规划器的驾驶行为。
en_tdlr: This work applies mechanistic interpretability to end-to-end self-driving by training sparse autoencoders on a planner's internal activations, revealing interpretable features aligned with route intent, speed, and braking behavior, and demonstrating that steering these latents produces predictable changes in driving outputs.
